notes: The Architect and Engineer of California, the 65 Internet Archive items from January 1921 to June 1959 (usmodernist-AECA-*). Every OCR sentence naming a corner, a side or line of a street, a block face or feet from a corner beside a word of building work was screened by script (539,072 sentences → 306 after removing other towns, advertisements and repeats), and a second pass took every 'corner of', 'cor.' and 'side/line of' context within reach of 'San Francisco' that the first had missed (152 more); the 458 were read by hand into 238 San Francisco job records, all with two streets, which went through research/tools/corner.py --batch with the record's year and, where it gives one, its storey count. Placement needed the roll year plus one more check — the storey count, the side of the street, lot area, a Planning building name, or the page already crediting the same architect. Numbered addresses were aeca-1905-1959-numbered; 1905–1920 corners were aeca-1905-1920-corners.
